options: A. 記者們一直在施壓市長，要求對預算赤字有更高的透明度
B. 記者們對市長的預算計畫表示贊同
C. 市長一直在要求記者保持透明
D. 市長正在掩蓋預算赤字的問題
normal.explain: Journalists have been pressing the mayor for more transparency regarding the budget deficit. (記者們一直向市長施壓，要求對預算赤字保持更高的透明度。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: All pertinent documentation is mandated to be published on the official city portal.
options: A. 所有相關文件都必須發表在實體報紙上
B. 規定所有相關文件都必須發布在官方城市入口網站上
C. 市政文件不需要公開
D. 網站上的文件正在被刪除
normal.explain: All pertinent documentation is mandated to be published on the official city portal. (強制規定所有相關文件都必須公布在官方的城市入口網站上。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The sudden policy reversal must have caught the local businesses completely off guard.
options: A. They have been planning this reversal for years.
B. Indeed, many shop owners are scrambling to adapt.
C. The policy is expected to be ignored.
D. Business owners must have guarded the policy.
normal.explain: The sudden policy reversal must have caught the local businesses completely off guard. (政策突然的反覆一定讓當地企業措手不及。) 回應 B (確實，許多店主正手忙腳亂地適應) 符合情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Our IT department has been upgrading the server infrastructure to minimize unexpected downtime.
options: A. 資訊部門一直造成系統意外當機
B. 資訊部門一直在升級伺服器基礎架構，以盡量減少意外的停機時間
C. 伺服器正在被移出基礎設施
D. 我們一直在等待伺服器自動修復
normal.explain: Our IT department has been upgrading the server infrastructure to minimize unexpected downtime. (我們的資訊部門一直在升級伺服器基礎架構，以將意外的停機時間降到最低。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The critical security patch is scheduled to be deployed across the network tonight.
options: A. 關鍵的安全修補程式預計在今晚部署到整個網路
B. 網路安全問題將在今晚被徹底忽略
C. 修補程式必須被刪除
D. 網路將在今晚永遠關閉
normal.explain: The critical security patch is scheduled to be deployed across the network tonight. (關鍵的安全修補程式預定於今晚在整個網路上部署。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The hackers must have exploited an unknown vulnerability in our legacy software.
options: A. We have been hacking the system all day.
B. Yes, the forensics team found a backdoor in the old code.
C. The vulnerability is highly anticipated.
D. They must have been very ethical.
normal.explain: The hackers must have exploited an unknown vulnerability in our legacy software. (駭客一定利用了我們舊版軟體中未知的漏洞。) 回應 B (是的，鑑識團隊在舊程式碼中發現了後門) 銜接自然。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been monitoring the network traffic for any signs of unauthorized access.
options: A. 我們正在建立新的無障礙網路
B. 我們一直在監控網路流量，以尋找未經授權存取的任何跡象
C. 我們停止監控網路，因為流量太大了
D. 授權人員一直無法存取網路
normal.explain: We have been monitoring the network traffic for any signs of unauthorized access. (我們一直在監控網路流量，留意是否有任何未經授權存取的跡象。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: User credentials are strictly required to be encrypted before transmission.
options: A. 使用者憑證在傳輸前會被解密
B. 嚴格規定使用者憑證在傳輸前必須先加密
C. 使用者憑證不需要任何保護
D. 傳輸過程被嚴格禁止
normal.explain: User credentials are strictly required to be encrypted before transmission. (嚴格規定使用者憑證在傳輸前必須進行加密。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The prolonged outage must have been caused by a massive hardware failure.
options: A. I heard the primary storage array completely burned out.
B. We have been trying to cause an outage.
C. The hardware is expected to be flawless.
D. It must have been a very quick fix.
normal.explain: The prolonged outage must have been caused by a massive hardware failure. (長時間的停機一定是因大規模硬體故障所引起的。) 回應 A (我聽說主儲存陣列完全燒毀了) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The support agents have been dealing with a surge of complaints regarding the delayed shipments.
options: A. 客服人員正在處理出貨系統的升級
B. 客服人員一直面臨大量關於貨運延遲的客訴
C. 貨物已經全數順利送達
D. 代理商正在阻止客訴的產生
normal.explain: The support agents have been dealing with a surge of complaints regarding the delayed shipments. (客服人員一直在處理因貨物延誤而激增的投訴。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The damaged goods are authorized to be disposed of by the local facility.
options: A. 當地設施被授權處理（丟棄）這些損壞的貨物
B. 當地設施拒絕接收損壞的貨物
C. 損壞的貨物必須被修復並重新出售
D. 貨物被完好無缺地保存在倉庫中
normal.explain: The damaged goods are authorized to be disposed of by the local facility. (受損的貨物被授權由當地設施進行報廢處理。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The delivery drone must have deviated from its pre-programmed route.
options: A. It has been flying perfectly on course.
B. Yes, the GPS logs show it headed into a restricted zone.
C. The drone is expected to be grounded.
D. We must have programmed the package.
normal.explain: The delivery drone must have deviated from its pre-programmed route. (送貨無人機一定是偏離了預先設定的路線。) 回應 B (是的，GPS 日誌顯示它飛進了限制區) 符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Critics have been scrutinizing the chef’s unorthodox approach to classic dishes.
options: A. 評論家們正在讚美主廚傳統的料理手法
B. 評論家們一直在嚴格審視主廚對經典菜餚的非傳統做法
C. 主廚拒絕接受任何評論家的意見
D. 這道經典菜色從未被評論過
normal.explain: Critics have been scrutinizing the chef’s unorthodox approach to classic dishes. (評論家們一直在仔細審視主廚處理經典菜餚的非正統做法。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The seasonal menu is designed to be paired with their extensive wine collection.
options: A. 季節菜單的設計是為了搭配他們豐富的葡萄酒收藏
B. 季節菜單將不提供任何酒精飲料
C. 葡萄酒收藏被賣給了其他餐廳
D. 菜單上的菜色與葡萄酒完全不搭
normal.explain: The seasonal menu is designed to be paired with their extensive wine collection. (季節性菜單是專為搭配他們豐富的葡萄酒收藏而設計的。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The culinary award must have boosted the restaurant's reputation immensely.
options: A. They have been losing customers steadily.
B. Definitely, they're fully booked for the next three months.
C. The award is considered to be fake.
D. We must have cooked the reputation.
normal.explain: The culinary award must have boosted the restaurant's reputation immensely. (這個烹飪獎項一定極大地提升了該餐廳的聲譽。) 回應 B (絕對是，他們接下來三個月的訂位都滿了) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The panelists have been answering challenging questions from the audience for an hour.
options: A. 座談會小組成員已經回答觀眾的尖銳問題長達一小時
B. 座談會小組拒絕回答任何問題
C. 觀眾一直在台上發表演講
D. 問題太過簡單，一小時內就問完了
normal.explain: The panelists have been answering challenging questions from the audience for an hour. (座談會的專家小組一直在回答觀眾提出的具挑戰性問題，已經持續一小時了。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The supplementary data is heavily relied upon to be conclusive.
options: A. 補充數據被認為是完全沒有用的
B. 補充數據被高度依賴以作為決定性的結論
C. 數據正在被慢慢刪除
D. 結論已經出爐，不需要補充數據
normal.explain: The supplementary data is heavily relied upon to be conclusive. (為了得出確鑿的結論，非常依賴這份補充數據。)

normal.desc: 【時態】The board of directors ___ potential mergers since the new fiscal year began.
options: A. assess
B. are assessing
C. have been assessing
D. will assess
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾有 since 加上過去時間點，表示從過去一直持續到現在的動作，且強調持續性，應使用現在完成進行式 (have been V-ing)。選項 C 正確。A 為現在簡單式，B 為現在進行式，D 為未來式，皆不符合時間標記。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The unprecedented revenue growth is projected ___ by a new digital infrastructure.
options: A. to drive
B. to be driven
C. driving
D. to have driven
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：project (預計) 後方接不定詞 to V，而營收成長是「被」數位基礎設施所驅動，因此需要用不定詞的被動語態 to be p.p.。選項 B 正確。A 是主動，C 是動名詞，D 是主動的完成式，皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】We secured the dominant market share. Our competitors ___ our aggressive expansion plan.
options: A. should dismiss
B. must have dismissed
C. can dismiss
D. ought to dismiss
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：前句提到「我們取得了主導市佔率（已發生的事實）」，後句推測對手過去一定做錯了什麼決定，表示對過去事實的強烈推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B (一定忽視了) 正確。A 和 D 表示「應該忽視(但沒做)」，C 為現在的能力或許可，皆不合理。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The CEO highlighted the company's ___ in navigating the unpredictable supply chain disruptions.
options: A. resilience
B. transparency
C. aesthetics
D. interpretation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：resilience 意思是「韌性、適應力」，符合句意「CEO 強調公司在應對不可預測的供應鏈中斷時所展現的韌性」。B 為透明度，C 為美學，D 為解釋，皆不符合語境。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the shareholders approve the dividend payout?
B: Yes, a generous dividend is confirmed ___ to all investors next month.
options: A. to distribute
B. distributing
C. to be distributed
D. distributed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：confirm 後方如接動作，常見為 is confirmed to V (被確認將會...)。股息 (dividend) 是「被分配」給投資人，所以要用被動語態 to be distributed。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Shareholder Letter: We have been expanding our footprint in emerging markets. This strategic ___ is anticipated to yield substantial returns by 2028. Management must have foreseen the stagnation in domestic sales.
Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. disruption
B. limitation
C. diversification
D. stagnation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到公司一直在新興市場擴張版圖，這種「多元化/分散投資 (diversification)」預計將帶來回報。A 是中斷，B 是限制，D 是停滯，皆與擴張版圖的正面策略不符。

normal.desc:
【短文】Shareholder Letter: Our operational costs are reported to have spiked last quarter. The sudden surge in raw material prices must have caught the procurement team off guard. We have been restructuring the supplier contracts to mitigate this issue.
Q: What is the main cause of the increased costs?
options: A. The restructuring of supplier contracts
B. The drop in product quality
C. The sudden rise in raw material prices
D. The hiring of a new procurement team
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到「The sudden surge in raw material prices must have caught the procurement team off guard. (原物料價格突然飆升一定讓採購團隊措手不及)」，這正是營運成本飆升 (spiked) 的主因。選項 C 符合文章內容。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To ensure long-term stability, we plan to ___ our surplus capital into renewable energy ventures.
options: A. hinder
B. taint
C. channel
D. suppress
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：channel 在此作動詞，意為「引導、投入（資金等）」。句意為「我們計畫將剩餘資金投入再生能源事業」。A 為阻礙，B 為污染，D 為壓制，皆不符合語意。

normal.desc: 【時態】Astronomers ___ the irregular orbit of the newly discovered exoplanet for several months.
options: A. have been tracking
B. has tracked
C. track
D. are tracking
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：時間標記為 for several months，表示從過去持續到現在的動作，主詞 Astronomers 為複數，故選 have been tracking (現在完成進行式)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden mass extinction event is hypothesized ___ by a series of massive volcanic eruptions millions of years ago.
options: A. to trigger
B. to be triggering
C. to have been triggered
D. triggering
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：事件是「被」引發，故需用被動語態。又因為引發的動作發生在數百萬年前，比 is hypothesized (現在被假設) 更早發生，因此要用完成式的被動 to have been p.p.。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The fossil was found in a deep marine rock layer. The creature ___ in a shallow sea environment.
options: A. must not dwell
B. cannot have dwelled
C. should have dwelled
D. might dwell
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：化石是在「深海」岩層中發現的，因此推測該生物「不可能」棲息在淺海環境。對過去事實的強烈否定推測用 cannot (can't) have + p.p.。B 正確。A 是現在禁止，C 是過去應該做卻沒做，D 是現在或未來的弱推測。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The ability of certain bacteria to survive extreme radiation remains an intriguing ___ to modern biologists.
options: A. transparency
B. consolidation
C. enigma
D. motive
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：enigma 意指「謎、難以理解的事物」。句意為「某些細菌在極端輻射下存活的能力，對現代生物學家來說仍是個有趣的謎」。A 為透明度，B 為鞏固，D 為動機。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why are they studying these deep-sea vents?
B: The unique ecosystem there is thought ___ crucial clues about the origins of life on Earth.
options: A. to hold
B. to be held
C. holding
D. to have been held
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is thought 後方接 to V。深海熱泉的生態系統「主動擁有/包含 (hold)」了生命起源的線索，所以用主動語態 to hold 即可，不需被動。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Cosmos Today: The rover has been drilling into the Martian surface to collect soil samples. Traces of ancient organic molecules are confirmed to have been detected in the latest batch. The planet must have harbored liquid water at some point in its history.
Q: What does the detection of organic molecules suggest?
options: A. The rover needs maintenance
B. The planet likely had liquid water in the past
C. The drilling process is complete
D. The soil samples are contaminated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後一句指出「The planet must have harbored liquid water at some point in its history. (該行星歷史上某個時期一定曾擁有液態水)」，這是基於偵測到有機分子所作出的推論。選項 B 符合。

normal.desc: 【時態】The research institute ___ funding for its controversial cloning project since the ethical debate intensified.
options: A. has been losing
B. are losing
C. is lost
D. to lose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：since 連接過去時間 (倫理辯論加劇之時)，主要子句應使用現在完成進行式表示動作持續至今。主詞為單數，故選 has been losing。

normal.desc: 【時態】Concerned citizens ___ outside the city hall to protest the proposed zoning laws for three consecutive days.
options: A. rally
B. are rallying
C. have been rallying
D. rallied
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：有 for three consecutive days (連續三天) 的時間區段，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式 have been rallying。A 為現在簡單式，B 為現在進行式，D 為過去簡單式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The historic library in the town center is expected ___ into a commercial complex next year.
options: A. to transform
B. to be transformed
C. transforming
D. to have transformed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：圖書館是「被改建」成商業綜合體，且預期發生在明年 (next year)，is expected 後接不定詞，故選擇 to be transformed (被動)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The mayor approved the demolition of the park. He ___ the immense historical value of that green space.
options: A. must have disregarded
B. should disregard
C. can disregard
D. will disregard
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：市長已經批准了拆除案 (過去式 approved)，所以我們推論他當時「一定忽視了」那片綠地的歷史價值。對過去事實的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】It is utterly ___ that the municipal council decided to cut funding for public transportation while increasing parking fees.
options: A. immersive
B. preposterous
C. evocative
D. retrospective
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：preposterous 意為「荒謬的、乖戾的」。句意為「市議會決定削減大眾運輸資金，同時卻提高停車費，這絕對是荒謬的」。A 為沉浸式，C 為喚起情感的，D 為回顧的。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you read the editorial about the new stadium?
B: Yes, the construction costs are reported ___ the initial budget by millions of dollars.
options: A. to exceed
B. to have exceeded
C. exceeding
D. exceeded
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：are reported 後接 to V，但因為「超出預算」是已經發生的事實，比「被報導」(現在) 更早發生，因此要用完成不定詞 to have exceeded。主動語態即可，因為花費主動超出預算。

normal.desc:
【短文】Letter to the Editor: I have been living in this neighborhood for two decades. The recent surge in property taxes is alleged to have driven many long-term residents away. The local government must have forgotten that working-class families are the backbone of this community.
Q: What is the writer's main complaint?
options: A. Working-class families are causing traffic
B. The neighborhood has become too noisy
C. High property taxes are forcing long-term residents to move
D. The local government is building new houses
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：投書中提到「The recent surge in property taxes is alleged to have driven many long-term residents away (近期財產稅的飆升據稱已逼走許多長期居民)」，這是作者的主要抱怨。選項 C 符合。

normal.desc:
【短文】Reader's Voice: The sanitation department has been neglecting the waste collection schedule in the eastern district. The overflowing bins are widely recognized to be a severe public health hazard. The authorities must have diverted their resources to the wealthier neighborhoods.
Q: What does the writer suspect the authorities did?
options: A. They hired more sanitation workers
B. They redirected their resources to richer areas
C. They bought new waste bins
D. They increased the budget for the eastern district
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：作者寫道「The authorities must have diverted their resources to the wealthier neighborhoods (當局一定把資源轉移到較富裕的街區了)」。選項 B (redirected their resources to richer areas) 是 divert 的同義表達。

normal.desc: 【字彙】As a taxpayer, I demand greater ___ regarding how the infrastructure funds are being spent by the city council.
options: A. transparency
B. plumage
C. motive
D. exoplanet
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：transparency 意為「透明度」。句意：「作為納稅人，我要求市議會在如何花費基礎設施資金方面要有更高的透明度」。B 為羽毛，C 為動機，D 為系外行星。

normal.desc: 【時態】Legal experts ___ the implications of this landmark Supreme Court decision since it was announced yesterday morning.
options: A. are scrutinizing
B. have been scrutinizing
C. scrutinize
D. will scrutinize
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句子有 since + 過去時間點，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應使用現在完成進行式。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The multinational corporation is ruled ___ antitrust laws by monopolizing the software distribution market.
options: A. to have violated
B. to be violated
C. violating
D. to violate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：法庭裁決 (is ruled) 是現在式，但公司「違反」反托拉斯法是過去已發生的動作，所以用完成不定詞 to have violated。因為公司是主動違反法律，不需被動。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The defendant fled the country hours before the verdict. He ___ a tip-off from someone inside the courthouse.
options: A. will obtain
B. must have obtained
C. should obtain
D. could obtain
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：被告在判決前幾個小時逃離國家，所以推論他過去「一定已經獲得」了內部消息。對過去的強烈推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The judge dismissed the case because the evidence presented by the prosecution was entirely ___ and lacked a solid factual basis.
options: A. circumstantial
B. immersive
C. resilient
D. transparent
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：circumstantial 意思是「依據情況的、間接的 (證據)」。circumstantial evidence 意指間接證據。句意為證據全是間接的且缺乏堅實的事實基礎，故法官駁回案件。B 沉浸式，C 有韌性的，D 透明的。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the appellate court overturn the previous ruling?
B: The original trial is found ___ tainted by severe jury tampering.
options: A. to be
B. being
C. to have been
D. having been
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is found 後接 to V。「原審被發現遭到陪審團干擾而受污染」，原審是過去的事，比 is found (現在) 更早發生，因此用 to have been p.p. (完成不定詞的被動形式)。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Legal Times: The pharmaceutical company has been facing a massive class-action lawsuit. Their flagship painkiller is proven to have caused severe cardiac side effects. The executives must have suppressed the clinical trial data to secure FDA approval.
Q: What did the executives allegedly do?
options: A. They recalled the painkiller
B. They hid negative medical data from the trials
C. They increased the price of the drug
D. They sued the FDA
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到 executives (高管) must have suppressed the clinical trial data (一定壓下了臨床試驗數據)。suppress 意指隱瞞、壓制。選項 B (hid negative medical data) 為同義改寫，故正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Court News Daily: The celebrity chef has been battling copyright infringement claims over his bestselling cookbook. Several recipes are deemed to have been blatantly plagiarized from a lesser-known blogger. The chef's legal team must have advised him to settle out of court to avoid further embarrassment.
Q: What is the celebrity chef accused of?
options: A. Using expired ingredients
B. Insulting a lesser-known blogger
C. Stealing recipes from someone else
D. Publishing his cookbook too late
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文指出「Several recipes are deemed to have been blatantly plagiarized (多個食譜被認為是公然抄襲)」，因此名廚被控訴的是竊取他人的食譜 (Stealing recipes)。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The defense attorney argued that his client had no ___ to commit the crime, as he stood to gain nothing from it.
options: A. interpretation
B. motive
C. retrospective
D. consolidation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：motive 意思是「動機」。句意：「辯護律師主張他的委託人沒有犯罪動機，因為他無法從中獲利」。A 為解釋，C 為回顧，D 為鞏固。

normal.desc: 【時態】Art critics ___ the controversial installation piece since the gallery opened last Thursday.
options: A. have been praising
B. are praising
C. praised
D. praise
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾的 since 加上過去時間點 (last Thursday) 是現在完成式或現在完成進行式的標誌。選項 A 符合，表示從上週四開始持續讚賞到現在。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The Renaissance masterpiece is rumored ___ to the national museum by an anonymous billionaire.
options: A. to donate
B. to be donating
C. to have been donated
D. to have donated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：畫作是「被」捐贈，且由上下文得知捐贈動作應已發生，因此在 is rumored (被謠傳) 後方使用完成式被動 to have been donated。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The lighting in the exhibition hall is perfectly designed. The curator ___ a lot of time arranging the spotlights.
options: A. must invest
B. must have invested
C. should invest
D. might invest
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：展廳的燈光設計很完美 (現在的事實)，推論館長過去「一定投入了」許多時間。對過去的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The contemporary sculpture exhibition offers a deeply ___ look into the devastating effects of climate change.
options: A. evocative
B. circumstantial
C. preposterous
D. controversial
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：evocative 意思是「喚起(情感/記憶)的、引起共鳴的」。句意為該展覽對氣候變遷的破壞性影響提供了深刻且發人深省/引起共鳴的視角。B 間接的，C 荒謬的，D 具爭議的 (此處理論上也可，但 evocative 更符合藝術評論的語境與 deeply 搭配)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you see the new photography exhibit?
B: Yes, the vintage portraits are considered ___ the essence of post-war society beautifully.
options: A. to be captured
B. to capture
C. capturing
D. having captured
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：are considered 後方接 to V。肖像畫「捕捉」(capture) 社會本質是主動的動作，用 to capture 即可。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Art Today: The local museum has been hosting a retrospective of the late painter's work. The early sketches are believed to have been heavily influenced by Japanese woodblock prints. The artist must have studied abroad during his formative years.
Q: What influenced the painter's early sketches?
options: A. The local museum
B. Japanese woodblock prints
C. His later paintings
D. European sculptures
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到「The early sketches are believed to have been heavily influenced by Japanese woodblock prints (早期素描被認為深受日本木版畫影響)」。選項 B 完全符合。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The exhibition successfully blends interactive media with traditional ___ to create a unique sensory experience.
options: A. aesthetics
B. consolidation
C. motives
D. exoplanets
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：aesthetics 意為「美學、審美觀」。句意為「展覽成功將互動媒體與傳統美學結合，創造獨特的感官體驗」。其他選項皆與藝術展覽語境不符。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Business Review: The retail giant's downfall is generally understood to have been triggered by its failure to adapt to e-commerce. For years, executives had been ignoring the digital shift, mistakenly believing their brick-and-mortar dominance was unassailable. They must have severely miscalculated consumer behavior. Now, large-scale layoffs are expected to be announced. Q: Which of the following best describes the executives' past mindset?
options: A. They were overly confident in their physical stores.
B. They were pioneering the transition to digital sales.
C. They have been constantly restructuring the company.
D. They expected the layoffs to boost their stock price.
boss.explain: 文中指出主管們誤以為他們的實體店優勢是無懈可擊的 (mistakenly believing their brick-and-mortar dominance was unassailable)，代表他們對實體店過度自信。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Science Journal: Anthropologists have been debating the purpose of the newly discovered ruins. The complex structure is hypothesized to have been utilized as a celestial observatory. Given the precision of the stonework, the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge. Q: What is the main conclusion drawn about the ancient builders?
options: A. They struggled with complex architectural designs.
B. They were highly skilled in mathematics.
C. They used the ruins primarily for religious rituals.
D. They have been living in the region for centuries.
boss.explain: 短文推論「the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge」（建造者一定具備先進的數學知識），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Policy Paper Summary: The proposed carbon tax has been facing fierce opposition from industrial sectors. Proponents argue that the measure is essential and is proven to have reduced emissions in neighboring countries. The government's failure to consult industry leaders beforehand must have exacerbated the backlash. Q: Why did the policy face a severe backlash according to the passage?
options: A. It failed to reduce emissions in neighboring countries.
B. The government did not communicate with industry leaders in advance.
C. Industrial sectors have been demanding higher taxes.
D. Proponents did not believe the measure was essential.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The government's failure to consult industry leaders beforehand must have exacerbated the backlash」（政府事前未諮詢業界領袖一定加劇了反彈）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Tech News: Developers have been working around the clock to patch a critical vulnerability. The security flaw is reported to have compromised the data of millions of users. The company's stock plummeted following the breach; investors must have panicked over the potential legal liabilities. Q: What was the consequence of the security flaw?
options: A. The developers were sued by the investors.
B. Millions of users lost their internet connection.
C. The company's stock value dropped sharply.
D. The vulnerability was patched before any data was lost.
boss.explain: 文章明確指出「The company's stock plummeted following the breach」（漏洞發生後公司股票暴跌）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Editorial Opinion: The housing crisis is often said to have been caused solely by foreign investors. However, domestic policies have been restricting urban development for decades. The city council must have ignored the growing population metrics when zoning the residential areas. Q: What does the author believe is a major factor in the housing crisis?
options: A. An influx of foreign workers.
B. Restrictive domestic urban development policies.
C. Overdevelopment of residential areas.
D. Accurate tracking of population metrics.
boss.explain: 作者認為雖然常被說是外國投資者造成的，但國內政策數十年來一直在限制都市發展 (domestic policies have been restricting...)，這才是真正的關鍵因素。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Not only ___ a profound impact on the local economy, but the new infrastructure is also expected to attract foreign investment.
options: A. the project has had
B. has the project had
C. the project is having
D. is the project had
boss.explain: 否定副詞 Not only 放句首時，後方需接倒裝句型（助動詞移至主詞前），故選 has the project had。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Medical Breakthrough: A new synthetic compound is purported to have cured several autoimmune diseases in clinical trials. Researchers have been refining its chemical structure to minimize side effects. The initial funding agency must have recognized its immense potential early on, given their continuous financial support. Q: What are researchers currently trying to achieve?
options: A. Secure more funding from the agency.
B. Reduce the side effects of the synthetic compound.
C. Prove that autoimmune diseases are incurable.
D. Patent the chemical structure globally.
boss.explain: 文中指出「Researchers have been refining its chemical structure to minimize side effects」（研究人員一直在改良其化學結構以將副作用降至最低）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Corporate Memo: The merger with Apex Corp is anticipated to be finalized by the fourth quarter. Both legal teams have been scrutinizing the contractual obligations diligently. Any discrepancies found now must have been overlooked during the initial audit phase. Q: What is implied about the initial audit phase?
options: A. It was conducted flawlessly without errors.
B. It was handled exclusively by Apex Corp.
C. It might not have been thorough enough.
D. It was deliberately delayed by the legal teams.
boss.explain: 文中提到「現在發現的任何差異一定是在初步審計階段被忽略的」，暗示初步審計可能不夠徹底。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Travel Advisory: Travelers have been experiencing unprecedented delays at the international terminal due to a staff strike. The situation is estimated to be resolved within 48 hours. Passengers whose flights were cancelled must have been notified via email or text message. Q: What caused the delays at the international terminal?
options: A. Severe weather conditions.
B. A malfunction in the booking system.
C. A work stoppage by employees.
D. Unprecedented passenger volume.
boss.explain: 短文指出延誤是由於「staff strike」（員工罷工），即選項中的 work stoppage by employees。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Scarcely ___ the press conference when a reporter asked a provocative question about the scandal.
options: A. had the CEO begun
B. the CEO had begun
C. has the CEO begun
D. the CEO began
boss.explain: 否定副詞 Scarcely 放句首時需倒裝，且配合 when 引導的過去式子句，主要子句應用過去完成式，故選 had the CEO begun。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Environmental Report: The shrinking of the ice caps is widely acknowledged to have accelerated over the last decade. Scientists have been urging policymakers to implement stringent regulations. The continuous dismissal of these warnings must have contributed significantly to the current ecological crisis. Q: What is the main point regarding policymakers?
options: A. They have successfully implemented stringent regulations.
B. Their disregard of scientific warnings worsened the crisis.
C. They are widely acknowledged to have accelerated the research.
D. They have been urging scientists to collect more data.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The continuous dismissal of these warnings must have contributed significantly...」（不斷忽視這些警告肯定大大促成了當前的危機），指出決策者的忽視使情況惡化。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Art History Analysis: The stolen masterpiece is now believed to have been smuggled out of the country in a freight container. Detectives have been tracking a notorious art syndicate connected to the heist. Security guards at the museum must have been bribed, as the alarm system was manually disabled. Q: How did the thieves likely manage to disable the alarm system?
options: A. By hacking into the main server.
B. By paying off the museum's security personnel.
C. By smuggling a device in a freight container.
D. By cutting the power supply to the building.
boss.explain: 文中明確推測「Security guards at the museum must have been bribed」（保全一定被收買了），對應選項 B (paying off security personnel)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The true operational costs have been deliberately obscured by the accounting firm.
options: A. 會計師事務所大幅降低了實際的營運成本。
B. 真實的營運成本已經被清晰且透明地公開。
C. 真實的營運成本已被會計師事務所蓄意掩蓋。
D. 會計師事務所發現了營運成本中的重大錯誤。
boss.explain: The true operational costs have been deliberately obscured by the accounting firm. (真實的營運成本已被會計師事務所蓄意掩蓋。) obscure 作動詞指「掩蓋、使模糊」；deliberately 意為「蓄意地」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The domestic economy must have been more resilient to inflation than the experts predicted.
options: A. 國內經濟對通貨膨脹的反應非常脆弱且敏感。
B. 經濟專家極度準確地預測了經濟的反彈趨勢。
C. 國內經濟完全沒有受到任何通貨膨脹的影響。
D. 國內經濟對通膨的抵抗力一定比專家預測的更強。
boss.explain: The domestic economy must have been more resilient to inflation than the experts predicted. (國內經濟對通膨的抵抗力一定比專家預測的更強。) resilient 指「有韌性的、能迅速恢復的」；must have been 表強烈推測。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The consistently high interest rates have been deterring potential foreign investors.
options: A. 持續的高利率一直阻礙著潛在的外國投資者。
B. 持續的高利率成功吸引了大量的外國資金。
C. 潛在的投資者對目前的高利率狀態毫不在乎。
D. 外國投資者持續要求銀行提供更高的利率。
boss.explain: The consistently high interest rates have been deterring potential foreign investors. (持續的高利率一直阻礙著潛在的外國投資者。) deter 指「阻嚇、使打消念頭」；使用現在完成進行式強調此現象持續發生。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: An intricate network of environmental sensors is being installed across the metropolitan area.
options: A. 城市目前正在拆除原本極為複雜的感測器網路。
B. 一個複雜的環境感測器網路正在大都會區安裝中。
C. 一個簡易且基礎的感測器網路已經安裝完畢。
D. 大都會區嚴重缺乏用於監控環境的感測器硬體。
boss.explain: An intricate network of environmental sensors is being installed across the metropolitan area. (一個複雜的環境感測器網路正在大都會區安裝中。) intricate 指「錯綜複雜的」；is being installed 為現在進行被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Several key financial details must have been omitted from the final quarterly report.
options: A. 最終的季度報告完整包含了所有的財務細節。
B. 季度報告中的一些細節被刻意過度強調了。
C. 最終的季報中一定遺漏了幾個關鍵的財務細節。
D. 公司的最終財務報告尚未編寫完成。
boss.explain: Several key financial details must have been omitted from the final quarterly report. (最終的季報中一定遺漏了幾個關鍵的財務細節。) omit 指「遺漏、省略」；must have been omitted 結合了情態動詞與被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She has been taking a significantly more prominent role in the international trade negotiations.
options: A. I heard she recently resigned from her corporate role.
B. International trade volumes are unfortunately declining.
C. The negotiations have been stalled for weeks anyway.
D. Her leadership has really helped push things forward.
boss.explain: She has been taking a significantly more prominent role in the international trade negotiations. (她在國際貿易談判中一直扮演著更為突出的角色。) prominent 指「突出的、顯著的」；回應讚賞她的領導能力推動了進展最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A rapid shift towards renewable energy sources is being strongly advocated by policy makers.
options: A. 政策制定者正強烈主張迅速轉向再生能源。
B. 政策制定者極力反對在近期內使用再生能源。
C. 轉向再生能源的全球性政策轉型已經徹底完成。
D. 目前沒有任何政府官員支持再生能源的發展計畫。

boss.explain: 原句：We have been scrutinizing the opponent's defensive formations for days. (我們這幾天一直在仔細審視對手的防守陣型。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The underdog must have capitalized on that rare unforced error.
options: A. 處於劣勢的一方在比賽中犯下了一個嚴重的失誤
B. 劣勢方一定利用了那個罕見的非受迫性失誤
C. 強隊故意製造失誤來讓對手得分
D. 裁判判斷這是一個合理的技術性犯規

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The executive coaching sessions are purported to be highly transformative.
options: A. I have been transforming the raw data.
B. Indeed, several managers spoke highly of them.
C. The coach must have missed the bus.
D. The sessions were unfortunately cancelled.
boss.explain: 原句：The executive coaching sessions are purported to be highly transformative. (高階主管教練課程據說非常具有變革性。) 選項 B (的確，有幾位經理對此評價很高) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They have been advocating for more inclusive hiring practices within the sector.
options: A. 他們拒絕在業界內推行任何新的招聘政策
B. 這個產業的招聘標準變得越來越嚴格
C. 他們一直在提倡業界內採取更具包容性的招聘實務
D. 公司決定解雇所有不符合包容性標準的員工
boss.explain: 原句：They have been advocating for more inclusive hiring practices within the sector. (他們一直在提倡業界內採取更具包容性的招聘實務。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Her exceptional portfolio must have distinguished her from the other candidates.
options: A. 她的作品集太過普通，未能吸引面試官的注意
B. 她出色的作品集一定讓她在其他候選人中脫穎而出
C. 其他候選人的作品集比她的更加優秀
D. 面試官根本沒有看她的作品集
boss.explain: 原句：Her exceptional portfolio must have distinguished her from the other candidates. (她出色的作品集一定讓她在其他候選人中脫穎而出。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: A comprehensive skills assessment is required to be completed by all attendees.
options: A. I will assess the damages immediately.
B. I have been looking for the test link. Where is it?
C. We must have assessed the wrong property.
D. The skills were acquired long ago.
boss.explain: 原句：A comprehensive skills assessment is required to be completed by all attendees. (所有與會者都必須完成一項全面的技能評估。) 選項 B (我一直在找測驗的連結。它在哪裡？) 最合理。

boss.desc:
【短文】HR Memo: The management has been reviewing the turnover metrics for the past quarter. The rigid office hours are suspected to have alienated our top performers. We must have ignored their requests for a better work-life balance for far too long.
Q: What is considered the main reason for losing top performers?
options: A. Low salaries
B. Inflexible schedules
C. Poor management
D. Lack of training
boss.explain: 文中提到「rigid office hours (僵化的辦公時間)」，也就是缺乏彈性的行程 (Inflexible schedules) 導致留不住優秀人才。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The department head's abrupt departure is presumed ___ by the crushing workload and insufficient administrative support.
options: A. to trigger
B. to be triggering
C. to have been triggered
D. triggering
boss.explain: 部門主管的離職被假定是「由龐大的工作量所引起的」。事情已發生且為被動，因此使用完成式被動不定詞 to have been triggered。

boss.desc: 【時態】The retention rate ___ gradually since the executives introduced a hybrid work model.
options: A. climbs
B. climbed
C. is climbing
D. has been climbing
boss.explain: 句中有 since 帶出的過去時間點，主句需用現在完成進行式，表示留任率從那時起持續在攀升中。

boss.desc:
【短文】Editorial: The proposed congestion pricing is said to have disproportionately affected low-income drivers. The policy makers must have prioritized municipal revenue over social equity when drafting the bill.
Q: What is the author's criticism of the policy makers?
options: A. They cared more about making money than fairness.
B. They built too many roads.
C. They ignored the environment.
D. They lowered taxes too much.
boss.explain: 社論批評政策制定者「prioritized municipal revenue over social equity (把市政收入置於社會公平之上)」，即只顧賺錢不顧公平。

boss.desc: 【推測語氣】The subway station was completely flooded during the storm. The city engineers ___ the drainage capacity accurately.
options: A. calculate
B. must not have calculated
C. should calculate
D. calculated
boss.explain: 地鐵站被淹沒了，可以強烈推斷工程師當時「一定沒有」準確計算好排水量，需用 must not have + V-p.p.。

boss.desc: 【時態】The local government ___ the subway fares continuously, causing widespread public outrage among daily commuters.
options: A. is hiked
B. hikes
C. has been hiking
D. hike
boss.explain: continuously 強調動作一直延續至今，政府不斷調漲票價，因此使用現在完成進行式 has been hiking。

boss.desc:
【短文】Investigative Report: The local dairy farm has been operating without a valid license. Their raw milk products are alleged to have caused a regional outbreak of listeria. The facility managers must have bribed the inspectors to ignore the gross health code violations.
Q: What did the factory managers allegedly do?
options: A. They improved sanitation.
B. They sold the farm.
C. They stopped production.
D. They paid off officials.
boss.explain: 文中指出經理「bribed the inspectors (賄賂檢查員)」，與 paid off officials 意思一致。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden closure of the popular bakery chain is rumored ___ by a severe pest infestation in their central kitchen.
options: A. to have been prompted
B. to prompt
C. prompting
D. to be prompted
boss.explain: 關店謠傳是「被」嚴重的蟲害所引起的。因為動作發生在過去且是被動，需用 to have been prompted。

boss.desc:
【短文】Article: Security experts have been monitoring the new smart home devices. The built-in microphones are proven to have recorded private conversations without consent. The manufacturer must have intentionally hidden this tracking feature deep within the terms of service.
Q: What is the main concern regarding the smart devices?
options: A. They are too expensive.
B. They secretly record users.
C. They break down easily.
D. They consume too much power.
boss.explain: 文章指出麥克風在未經同意下錄下私人對話 (recorded private conversations without consent)，即暗中錄音。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The deployment of unregulated surveillance drones is feared ___ a chilling effect on public gatherings and free speech.
options: A. casting
B. to be cast
C. to have cast
D. cast
boss.explain: 無人機的部署被恐懼「已經產生了 (cast)」寒蟬效應，因是主動發出的動作且強調已造成影響，故選 to have cast。

boss.desc: 【推測語氣】The AI system completely failed to recognize the regional accents. The developers ___ it exclusively on standard dialects.
options: A. train
B. are training
C. should train
D. must have trained
boss.explain: 系統完全無法辨識地方口音，可推斷開發者當時「一定只用了」標準方言來訓練它，用 must have + V-p.p. 表過去的肯定推測。

boss.desc:
【短文】Marketing Review: Our rival brand has been dominating the digital space. Their latest interactive billboard is recognized to have captivated millions of pedestrians. Their creative team must have spent months studying foot traffic patterns to maximize visual impact.
Q: Why was the rival's billboard successful?
options: A. It was placed strategically based on data.
B. It was cheaper to produce.
C. It offered free samples.
D. It was endorsed by a celebrity.
boss.explain: 評論提到團隊「spent months studying foot traffic patterns (花了數月研究人潮模式)」，這代表廣告的成功是因為基於數據的策略性放置。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden rebranding effort is widely believed ___ by the new CEO's desire to distance the company from past scandals.
options: A. to drive
B. to have been driven
C. driving
D. driven
boss.explain: 品牌重塑被認為是「被新任CEO的渴望所驅動的」。已發生且為被動語態，需用 to have been driven。

🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The regional manager must have been anticipating this logistical nightmare when he requested the contingency plan.
options: A. Yes, his foresight really saved us from total paralysis today.
B. We have been ignoring the contingency plan completely.
C. The nightmare is predicted to be wonderful.

boss.explain: The regional manager must have been anticipating this logistical nightmare when he requested the contingency plan. (區域經理要求制定應急計畫時，一定早就預料到這場物流噩夢了。) 回應 A (是的，他的遠見確實拯救了我們今天免於全面癱瘓) 最契合語境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The entire freight network is purported to be operating at maximum capacity to clear the backlog.
options: A. 整個貨運網絡正在減班以節省成本
B. 據稱整個貨運網絡正以最大產能運作以清理積壓的貨物
C. 貨運網絡已經完全癱瘓
D. 積壓的貨物已經全數被銷毀
boss.explain: The entire freight network is purported to be operating at maximum capacity to clear the backlog. (據稱，整個貨運網絡正以最大負載運作，以清除積壓的貨物。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The exorbitant prices on the menu must have deterred a significant portion of their target demographic.
options: A. I have been eating there every day.
B. Exactly, many locals feel priced out and no longer visit.
C. The menu is expected to be incredibly cheap.
D. They must have deterred the chef from cooking.
boss.explain: The exorbitant prices on the menu must have deterred a significant portion of their target demographic. (菜單上高昂的價格一定嚇退了他們很大一部分的目標客群。) 回應 B (沒錯，許多當地人覺得價格太高而不再光顧) 是最精準的回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The complex flavor profile of this dish is intended to be unraveled slowly on the palate.
options: A. 這道菜的口味非常單調且無趣
B. 這道菜複雜的風味層次旨在讓味蕾慢慢去解析感受
C. 廚師希望客人快速吃完這道菜
D. 這道菜的味道過於強烈，難以下嚥
boss.explain: The complex flavor profile of this dish is intended to be unraveled slowly on the palate. (這道菜複雜的風味特徵是為了讓味蕾細細品味、慢慢解開而設計的。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The underlying premise of your research must have been challenged vigorously during the defense.
options: A. Yes, the committee grilled me on my theoretical framework for hours.
B. We have been accepting the premise without question.
C. The research is scheduled to be canceled.
D. I must have defended the committee.
boss.explain: The underlying premise of your research must have been challenged vigorously during the defense. (你研究的潛在前提在口試辯護時一定受到了強烈的質疑。) 回應 A (是的，委員會對我的理論框架盤問了好幾個小時) 正確對應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: These statistical anomalies are generally presumed to be caused by flaws in the sampling methodology.
options: A. 這些統計異常被證明是完美的結果
B. 這些統計上的異常狀況通常被推定為是抽樣方法上的瑕疵所致
C. 抽樣方法完全沒有任何缺陷
D. 統計異常是人為刻意捏造的
boss.explain: These statistical anomalies are generally presumed to be caused by flaws in the sampling methodology. (這些統計上的異常現象通常被推斷是由抽樣方法中的瑕疵引起的。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The incumbent governor must have deliberately evaded the reporter's question about the corruption scandal.
options: A. He has been answering every question transparently.
B. Absolutely, his pivot to infrastructure was a classic deflection tactic.
C. The corruption scandal is expected to be promoted.
D. The reporter must have evaded the press conference.
boss.explain: The incumbent governor must have deliberately evaded the reporter's question about the corruption scandal. (現任州長一定是故意迴避了記者關於貪污醜聞的提問。) 回應 B (絕對是，他轉移話題到基礎設施是經典的閃避策略) 語意相符。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The ambitious housing initiative is slated to be entirely subsidized by federal grants.
options: A. 這個雄心勃勃的住宅計畫預計將完全由聯邦政府補助
B. 住宅計畫將由市民自行籌資
C. 聯邦政府拒絕資助這項住宅計畫
D. 這項倡議已經被全盤否決
boss.explain: The ambitious housing initiative is slated to be entirely subsidized by federal grants. (這項雄心勃勃的住房倡議預定將完全由聯邦補助款提供資金。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The malicious ransomware must have circumvented our firewalls during the scheduled maintenance window.
options: A. We have been turning off the servers permanently.
B. It appears so; the logs show an intrusion at precisely 3 AM.
C. The firewalls are considered to be invulnerable.
D. They must have maintained the ransomware.
boss.explain: The malicious ransomware must have circumvented our firewalls during the scheduled maintenance window. (惡意勒索軟體一定是在預定的維護時段繞過了我們的防火牆。) 回應 B (看來是這樣；日誌顯示正好在凌晨三點有入侵跡象) 完全符合資安情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Routine system diagnostics are strictly required to be logged in the centralized repository.
options: A. 系統診斷結果不需要被保留下來
B. 嚴格要求例行的系統診斷記錄必須存入集中式資料庫
C. 只有嚴重的錯誤才需要被記錄
D. 集中式資料庫目前無法使用
boss.explain: Routine system diagnostics are strictly required to be logged in the centralized repository. (嚴格規定例行的系統診斷結果必須被記錄在集中的儲存庫中。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The sudden data loss must have severely compromised our operational integrity.
options: A. The operational integrity is flawless.
B. Indeed, several client accounts are currently unrecoverable.
C. We have been compromising the data deliberately.
D. The loss must have been a great benefit.
boss.explain: The sudden data loss must have severely compromised our operational integrity. (突如其來的數據遺失一定嚴重損害了我們的營運完整性。) 回應 B (確實，好幾個客戶帳戶目前無法恢復) 反映了嚴重性。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Redundancy protocols are strategically designed to be triggered upon primary server failure.
options: A. 備援協定被設計在主伺服器正常運作時關閉
B. 備援協定經策略性設計，會在主伺服器故障時觸發
C. 主伺服器故障時會導致所有資料被刪除
D. 這些協定完全沒有備份的作用
boss.explain: Redundancy protocols are strategically designed to be triggered upon primary server failure. (備援協定經過策略性設計，以便在主伺服器故障時被觸發。)

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Not only ___ our market share, but we have also been outperforming industry benchmarks consistently.
options: A. the new product boosted
B. has the new product boosted
C. the new product has boosted
D. did the new product boosted
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：Not only 置於句首時，其後的子句需倒裝 (助動詞移至主詞前)。後半句用現在完成進行式，前半句配合語意用現在完成式倒裝，has the new product boosted。選項 B 正確；D 助動詞 did 後面動詞未還原，為語法錯誤。

boss.desc:
【短文】Letter to Shareholders: Over the past year, we have been revamping our core software architecture. The legacy system is widely acknowledged to have hindered our agility. Our early investors must have worried about the technological debt we accumulated. Fortunately, the transition is now complete.
Q: What was the problem with the legacy system?
options: A. It was too expensive to maintain
B. It slowed down the company's responsiveness
C. It caused massive data leaks
D. It was not accessible to early investors
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指出舊系統 (legacy system)「hindered our agility (阻礙了我們的敏捷度)」。agility 指敏捷度、反應速度，選項 B (slowed down responsiveness) 為其同義改寫，故為正解。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The sudden mutation in the virus strain is highly ___ to the development of our new vaccine, rendering it less effective.
options: A. resilient
B. evocative
C. detrimental
D. immersive
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：detrimental 意為「有害的、不利的」。句意為病毒株的突變對疫苗開發「極為不利」，導致其效果降低。其他選項 (A 韌性的，B 喚起情感的，D 沉浸式的) 完全不合邏輯。

boss.desc:
【短文】Neuro-Science: Neuroscientists have been mapping the brain's neural pathways during deep sleep. Memory consolidation is proven to be facilitated by these slow-wave patterns. Individuals who sleep poorly must have experienced a significant disruption in this critical restorative phase.
Q: What happens during slow-wave sleep?
options: A. Neural pathways are permanently destroyed
B. Memories are strengthened and organized
C. The brain stops all internal activity
D. Individuals experience vivid nightmares
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到 Memory consolidation (記憶鞏固/強化) 是由慢波模式 (slow-wave patterns) 促進的。選項 B「記憶被強化與組織」正是 consolidation 的意義。

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Scarcely ___ the new recycling initiative when they realized they lacked the facilities to process the collected materials.
options: A. the city had launched
B. did the city launch
C. had the city launched
D. the city launched
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：否定副詞 Scarcely (幾乎不/一...就...) 置於句首時，主要子句需倒裝，通常搭配過去完成式 (had + S + p.p.)，後面跟 when 加上過去式子句。選項 C (had the city launched) 完全符合倒裝與時態規則。

boss.desc:
【短文】Opinion Page: We have been enduring endless traffic jams since the bridge repair began. The detour routes are proven to have been poorly planned. The urban planners must have relied on outdated traffic models, as they completely failed to account for rush-hour volume.
Q: Why are the detour routes ineffective?
options: A. They are too narrow for commercial trucks
B. The planners used old and inaccurate traffic data
C. Rush-hour volume has decreased recently
D. The bridge repair was unexpectedly canceled
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：投書中提到都市計畫者「must have relied on outdated traffic models (一定依賴了過時的交通模型)」，導致無法應付尖峰時段車流。選項 B (使用舊且不準確的數據) 為正解。

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Only after the whistleblower leaked the internal memos ___ the true extent of the corporate fraud.
options: A. the public realized
B. did the public realize
C. the public has realized
D. has the public realized
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：Only after 帶領的副詞子句置於句首時，後面的主要子句必須倒裝 (助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞)。又因為 leak 是過去式，主要子句也應為過去式倒裝，選項 B (did the public realize) 為正解。

boss.desc:
【短文】Judicial Review: The tech giant has been appealing the heavy fines imposed by the European Union. Their data collection practices are alleged to have infringed upon user privacy rights. The company's compliance officers must have deliberately bypassed the regional regulations.
Q: Why was the tech giant fined?
options: A. For failing to pay corporate taxes
B. For allegedly violating user privacy laws
C. For appealing the European Union's decision
D. For firing their compliance officers
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及「Their data collection practices are alleged to have infringed upon user privacy rights (他們的資料收集行為據稱侵犯了用戶隱私權)」。infringe upon 意為侵犯，選項 B (violating user privacy laws) 符合。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The artist's refusal to provide any description for his abstract paintings leaves their meaning completely open to ___.
options: A. transparency
B. consolidation
C. interpretation
D. plumage
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：open to interpretation 是一個常見片語，意為「開放給人自由詮釋」。藝術家不提供文字說明，使得抽象畫的意義完全開放給觀眾各自解讀。選項 C 正確。

boss.desc:
【短文】Gallery Review: The historical society has been showcasing a collection of rare medieval artifacts. A magnificent jewel-encrusted sword is purported to have belonged to a legendary king. The craftsmen who forged it must have possessed unparalleled metallurgical skills.
Q: What is said about the sword's creators?
options: A. They were members of the royal family
B. They were highly skilled in metalworking
C. They stole the jewels from a legendary king
D. They left detailed blueprints for the historical society
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中稱讚鍛造這把劍的工匠 (craftsmen)「must have possessed unparalleled metallurgical skills (一定擁有無與倫比的冶金/金屬加工技巧)」。選項 B (highly skilled in metalworking) 是準確的改寫。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science Weekly: Researchers have been observing the peculiar mating rituals of the bird of paradise. The vibrant plumage is considered to have evolved specifically to attract mates in dense jungles. The ancestors of these birds must have faced intense sexual selection pressures.
Q: Why did the vibrant plumage evolve?
options: A. To camouflage the birds in dense jungles
B. To attract potential mating partners
C. To frighten away dangerous predators
D. To help the birds fly faster
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章明確指出鮮豔的羽毛 (vibrant plumage) 被認為是為了「attract mates (吸引配偶)」而演化出來的。選項 B (attract potential mating partners) 完全相符。

boss.desc:
【短文】Exhibition Critique: We have been waiting in line for hours to see the immersive digital art show. The visual projections are reported to have crashed twice during the morning session. The technical team must have overlooked a fatal bug in the rendering software.
Q: What issue occurred during the morning session?
options: A. The gallery was closed due to a power outage
B. The visual projections failed to operate correctly
C. The technical team resigned unexpectedly
D. The audience refused to wait in line
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及「The visual projections are reported to have crashed twice (視覺投影據報崩潰了兩次)」，意即系統無法正常運作。選項 B 準確描述了投影失敗的問題。
